linkedinPhoto.subtitle: Upload a selfie, generate a professional LinkedIn headshot

linkedinPhoto.promptDefault:
Transform this casual selfie into a polished, corporate-grade LinkedIn headshot.

Identity preservation: Maintain the subject's exact facial structure, skin tone, eye color, hair color and style, and all distinguishing features — the result must be unmistakably the same person.

Lighting: Simulate a three-point studio setup — soft key light at 45° camera-left, gentle fill light camera-right, and a subtle rim/hair light to separate the subject from the background. Avoid harsh shadows or blown-out highlights.

Background: Clean, slightly out-of-focus neutral gradient (light grey to soft blue-grey). No distracting elements.

Composition: Tight head-and-shoulders crop, subject centered, eyes at upper-third line. Slight 10-15° body angle toward camera-left with face turned back toward camera for a natural editorial feel.

Attire & grooming: Refine clothing to appear neat and professional. Smooth minor skin blemishes while preserving natural skin texture — do not over-retouch.

Technical quality: Ultra-sharp focus on the eyes, shallow depth of field (f/2.8 equivalent), no chromatic aberration, no noise. Output resolution should match or exceed the input image.

Mood: Confident, approachable, and trustworthy — appropriate for senior professional or executive branding.

intro.title: Introduction
intro.body: CareerPilot (hereinafter "we") respects and protects user privacy. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, store, and protect your personal information. By using this service, you agree to the data practices described in this policy.

collection.title: Information We Collect
collection.body: We collect only the information necessary to provide our services, including:

items.account: Account information: registration email, display name, and avatar
items.resume: Resume content: resume data you actively create and edit
items.usage: Usage records: AI call logs, credit transactions, and activity logs
items.cookies: Technical information: session cookies and basic browser information

use.title: How We Use Information
use.body: The information we collect is used solely for the following purposes:

items.service: Providing and maintaining core features such as resume editing, AI optimization, and mock interviews
items.ai: Sending your resume content to platform-managed AI models for processing
items.security: Detecting and preventing fraud, abuse, and unauthorized access
items.communication: Sending you service notifications and important updates

sharing.title: Information Sharing
sharing.body: We do not sell, rent, or trade your personal information. Information may be shared only when: you give explicit consent; required by law or government authorities; necessary to protect the legitimate rights of the platform and its users. Organization administrators may view aggregated usage data for their organization but cannot access your resume content, interview transcripts, or full prompts.

retention.title: Data Retention
retention.body: Your personal data is retained while your account is active. After account deletion, business data is cascade-deleted according to the data graph; financial and security records required by law are anonymized.

rights.title: Your Rights
rights.body: You have the following rights regarding your personal information:

items.access: Access: view your personal data and usage details
items.export: Export: download a complete copy of your personal data
items.delete: Delete: close your account and delete associated data

security.title: Data Security
security.body: We protect your data using encrypted transmission (HTTPS), encrypted storage (key encryption), least-privilege access, and regular audits. AI provider credentials are encrypted with a separate master key; regular APIs and management logs never return plaintext keys.

contact.title: Contact Us
contact.body: If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy, please contact: <email>support@careerpilot.app</email>

acceptance.title: Acceptance of Terms
acceptance.body: By using the CareerPilot service, you agree to these Terms of Service. If you do not agree with any terms, please stop using the service.

accounts.title: Account Registration
accounts.body: You must register with a valid email address and are responsible for all activities under your account. Registering multiple accounts for abuse is prohibited. The platform reserves the right to suspend accounts that violate these terms.

credits.title: Credits and Quota
credits.body: Individual users receive credits through registration grants or platform adjustments. Organization users use credits allocated to their organization. All AI calls deduct credits according to published platform rules. Credits are non-transferable, non-refundable, and cannot be redeemed for cash unless otherwise specified.

ai.title: AI-Generated Content
ai.body: AI-generated resume content, interview evaluations, and suggestions are for reference only. The platform does not guarantee the accuracy, completeness, or suitability of AI outputs. Users should review all AI-generated content themselves.

orgUsage.title: Organization Usage
orgUsage.body: Organization administrators may manage their organization members and seats, and view aggregated usage data. Administrators cannot access members resume content, interview transcripts, or full prompts. AI consumption by organization members is deducted from the organization quota.

prohibited.title: Prohibited Conduct
prohibited.body: You must not engage in the following activities:

items.abuse: Abusing AI interfaces, including automated mass requests, scraping, or exceeding reasonable usage
items.reverse: Reverse engineering, decompiling, or attempting to obtain source code of the platform
items.unauthorized: Accessing other users resumes, interviews, or account data without authorization
items.illegal: Using the service for any illegal or infringing activities

disclaimer.title: Disclaimer
disclaimer.body: The service is provided "as is" without any express or implied warranties. The platform does not guarantee the availability, reliability, or accuracy of the service.

liability.title: Limitation of Liability
liability.body: To the maximum extent permitted by applicable law, the platform shall not be liable for any indirect, incidental, special, or consequential damages.

changes.title: Changes to Terms
changes.body: The platform reserves the right to modify these terms at any time. Material changes will be communicated through notifications or login prompts. Continued use of the service constitutes acceptance of the modified terms.

contact.title: Contact Us
contact.body: If you have any questions about these Terms of Service, please contact: <email>support@careerpilot.app</email>

changes.title: Ability change timeline

goals.description: Choose a primary occupation, target date, and preferences. Updates keep their history instead of overwriting past choices.

form.description: Changing the goal affects matching and growth tasks, so use your real intentions.
form.occupationHelp: Occupations come from a versioned catalog. The system never selects or scores one without an explicit goal.

form.rationalePlaceholder: For example: I enjoy solving real problems with technology and want to build product experience through frontend development…

jobs.title: Understand an occupation before choosing a direction
jobs.description: Review responsibilities, ability requirements, progression and transition paths, and verified sources.
jobs.loadFailed: The occupation catalog could not be refreshed. Current content has been preserved.

compare.title: Occupation comparison
compare.description: Compare 2–3 directions and their evidence without letting one score decide for you.
compare.help: {count}/3 occupations selected; choose at least 2 to compare

empty.title: No occupations found
empty.description: Try a shorter occupation name or category keyword.

jobDetail.standardOccupation: Chinese standard occupation · eligible for matching

reviewRequired.title: Candidate occupation knowledge pending review
reviewRequired.description: This occupation's ability requirements have not completed review. You may browse it, but matching and scoring are unavailable.

requirements.title: Ability requirements
requirements.description: Requirements come from official Chinese occupation sources. CareerPilot applies one evidence scale for deterministic matching and never treats missing evidence as zero.
requirements.emptyDescription: There are no reviewed requirements available for matching, so the system will not generate an occupation match score.

majors.title: Major–occupation relationships
majors.description: Core, adjacent, cross-major, and stretch paths come from reviewed catalog mappings.
majors.empty: No reviewed major mapping is available yet.

graph.title: Career relationships
graph.description: Explore progression, transition, and related directions.
graph.empty: No career relationships are recorded for this occupation yet.

sources.title: Knowledge sources
sources.description: Occupation explanations come from traceable sources, not model invention.
sources.standardTitle: Chinese sources: 2022 occupation classification and current national standards
sources.standardDescription: Codes and work tasks follow China's 2022 occupation classification. Where a current national occupation standard exists, its entry-level skill requirements take priority; other occupations use a simple model derived from the classification's official work tasks.
sources.empty: Source material is insufficient, so no unsupported conclusion is provided.

matching.title: See the size of the gap—and the reason behind it
matching.description: Official Chinese occupation requirements define each role, structured rules determine matching, and evidence determines confidence. RAG is used only for retrieval, explanation, and citations.

disclaimer.title: A match score is not a vocational qualification or skill-level decision
disclaimer.description: CareerPilot compares student evidence with occupation requirements on one 0–100 scale. The product threshold of 60 is not a national qualification exam score, skill-level assessment, hiring result, or licence.

matching.recalculateError: Unable to calculate the match. Try again later.
matching.confidenceDescription: Known requirements and verified evidence jointly determine confidence

compareForm.legend: Choose occupations to match and compare
compareForm.help: The primary occupation is required. Add one or two more; duplicates are removed.

noGoal.title: Choose a goal before matching
noGoal.description: The system will not default to the first occupation. Set a primary goal or explicitly choose what to explore above.

insufficient.title: Evidence coverage is too low to show a match score
insufficient.description: Sync resumes, projects, mock interviews, courses, or certificates. A score appears only after minimum thresholds are met.

notEligible.title: Candidate occupation knowledge pending review; scoring unavailable
notEligible.description: The structured requirements for this occupation have not completed review. This is not a problem with your materials; no match score will be calculated until the occupation knowledge is approved.

comparisonTable.title: Multi-occupation evidence comparison
comparisonTable.description: Compare match, evidence, and key gaps without recommending the highest score.
comparisonTable.caption: Match comparison for two or three occupations

summary.label: Match explanation summary
summary.strengthsDescription: Only evidence-backed abilities meeting requirements are shown
summary.gapsDescription: Required abilities and larger gaps come first
summary.actionsDescription: Each action maps to a real gap
summary.noStrengths: Current evidence is not enough to confirm a strength.
summary.noGaps: No priority gap has been confirmed.
summary.noActions: Add materials to generate targeted actions.

review.title: Request human review
review.description: Report an issue with requirements, ability mapping, or evidence attribution.
review.scope: Explain which requirement or evidence is inaccurate and include verifiable supporting material.
review.notice: This version sends review requests to support. It never changes scores or occupation knowledge automatically.

breakdown.title: Requirement → evidence → gap → action
breakdown.description: Expand each requirement to review student evidence and next-step advice.
breakdown.noEvidence: No material currently supports this ability.

sources.title: Sources used in this explanation
sources.description: Citations explain the result but never change the structured score.

materials.success: Processed {sources} materials and added {evidence} evidence items
materials.warning: Some materials could not be structured. Review them and try again.
materials.error: Unable to sync materials. Try again later.

evidenceSubmission.title: Submit ability evidence for teacher review
evidenceSubmission.description: Choose a specific requirement for your target occupation, “{occupation}”, and submit verifiable material. Students cannot score themselves.
evidenceSubmission.titlePlaceholder: For example: Frontend performance improvements for a campus booking system
evidenceSubmission.descriptionPlaceholder: Explain what you delivered, your contribution, the outcome, and how it supports this ability.
evidenceSubmission.sourceUrlPlaceholder: https://… project, portfolio, certificate, or report
evidenceSubmission.reviewNotice: Submission stays pending. Your profile and match update only after a teacher verifies it and records a 0–100 score.
evidenceSubmission.success: Ability evidence submitted for teacher review
evidenceSubmission.error: Unable to submit evidence. Check the target occupation and requirement, then try again.

path.title: Turn occupation gaps into actions you can take today
path.description: Move through tasks by stage. Completed work first becomes pending evidence and changes the career profile only after verification.
path.noTasks: No growth tasks are assigned to this stage yet.
path.taskCompleted: Task completed. Related work still needs evidence verification.
path.taskUpdateFailed: Unable to update the task. Try again later.

empty.title: Set a goal to generate a growth path
empty.description: The path connects your current preparation stage, target occupation, and optional future directions.

denied.title: Teacher workspace unavailable
denied.description: This account has no active teacher or career counselor role. Organization administration does not grant teacher access.

unconfigured.title: Teacher workspace is not configured
unconfigured.description: Ask a school administrator to assign an education role and student guidance relationships.

queue.pageDescription: Prioritize students who need review, have overdue work, or show meaningful changes, then complete guidance in their record.

content.sectionDescription: Items are grouped by the action they require, not by generic statistics.
content.emptyDescription: New evidence, goal changes, and task exceptions from assigned students will appear here.
content.studentSectionDescription: Open a student record from the queue to review evidence, paths, and create the next task.

evidence_review.title: Evidence review
evidence_review.description: Confirm or return ability evidence submitted by students

goal_change.title: Goal changed
goal_change.description: Review how a goal adjustment affects the growth path

overdue_task.title: Overdue tasks
overdue_task.description: Follow up on growth tasks past their due date

match_decline.title: Match declined
match_decline.description: Locate the evidence and gaps behind a lower match score

recent_progress.title: Recent progress
recent_progress.description: Review ability changes supported by new evidence

students.pageDescription: Only students assigned to you in the current school are shown; search and filters never expand data access.

content.searchPlaceholder: Name, major, year, or target occupation
content.emptyDescription: Clear the filters; if the list remains empty, ask a school administrator to check guidance assignments.

overview.title: Student overview
overview.description: Focus on current risks, ability changes, and next actions.
overview.attentionDescription: Evidence that requires a teacher's reason before confirmation or return.
overview.progressDescription: Positive changes supported by explicit evidence this period.
overview.nextActionDescription: Growth tasks still awaiting student completion or teacher follow-up.

profile.abilityDescription: Scores and evidence are separate; missing evidence is never treated as zero.
profile.evidenceDescription: Verify source, ability link, and status before confirmation. Results require a reason.
profile.noEvidenceDescription: Pending evidence appears after students submit materials or task results.

review.title: Confirm ability evidence
review.description: Choose a decision first. Confirmation requires a 0–100 score; returns never record a score. The result and reason are visible to the student.

review.reasonPlaceholder: Explain why this evidence does or does not support the ability

goals.emptyDescription: A student must choose a career goal before the system can generate a gap-based growth path.

tasks.title: Growth tasks
tasks.description: Tasks need an ability link, reason, due date, and verifiable completion criteria.
tasks.emptyDescription: Create a task above that maps directly to an ability gap.

guidance.title: Guidance history
guidance.description: Student-visible guidance and private teacher notes remain separate and keep their history.
guidance.emptyDescription: Add the first public guidance item or private teacher note.

guidance.contentPlaceholder: Describe the observation, supporting basis, and recommended next action

task.namePlaceholder: For example: build and deploy a responsive portfolio page
